thread:
jamie: Quick UX question — we need better visibility into automatic degradation decisions in Console.
Specifically:
- ops currently only sees "degraded" flag, not why
- audits are noisy (lots of tiny events) and unclear which users/clients were impacted
Can we sketch what the UI + API should surface?

sara: Agree. Two high-level needs: 1) explainability (why chosen variant) 2) compact audit with samples. 
For explainability I'd like a short human reason + structured tags (latency, error_rate, model_mismatch).

mike: From infra side, important to have machine-readable reason codes. e.g. `ERR_RATE_HIGH`, `P95_LATENCY`.
Also we should persist a pointer to the trace/span id so SRE can jump into traces.

lin: UI idea: a 'decision drawer' that shows timeline + top 3 contributing signals, and a small sample of sanitized requests (toggle to show).
Filters: by route, by customer, by model-variant. :eyes:

anya: Implementation note: decision service currently returns only `variant` and `timestamp`. We could add `decision_reason` (short string) and `reason_tags` array.
Prototype:
```
{
  "variant": "v1-quantized",
  "decision_reason": "p95_latency>1200ms",
  "reason_tags": ["P95_LATENCY", "MODEL_QUANTIZATION_FALLBACK"],
  "trace_id": "abcd1234",
  "sample_request_id": "req_987"
}
```

mike: Two concerns: 1) trace_id linking might include PII in payloads; we must ensure sampled request views are sanitized. 2) retention: audit entries could be large — need TTL policy per org.

lin: Sanitation plan: only store request metadata + hashed prompt prefix + client_id. For compliance, add a toggle per org to increase or decrease sampling/retention.

jamie: UX for audits: collapse repeated decision events into a single 'incident' with counts and top causes. Expand to see samples. Also show automated rollback actions and whether human override was triggered.

sara: Also need a Console surface for "policy diff" — when a rollout switches variants automatically, show the policy snapshot used (so an auditor can see exact thresholds at time T).

anya: We should version the policy blob and include `policy_id` and `policy_hash` in the decision. That makes diffs reproducible.

mike: API debate: should decision_explanation be free-text or structured only? Structured is easier to query but free-text helps operators.
Suggestion: both — `reason_tags` (structured) + `explain_short` (one-line human string). Limit `explain_short` to 256 chars.

jamie: Sounds good. Action items:
- add fields to decision API: `decision_reason`, `reason_tags`, `policy_id`, `policy_hash`, `trace_id`, `sample_request_id` — @anya to draft PR (ETA: EOD Thu)
- lin to mock Console drawer and sampling UX
- mike to propose retention defaults + PII sanitization checklist
- sara to add audit diff view and acceptance criteria in the rollout UX ticket (#PLAT-2398)

deploy-bot: policy-applier: auto-degrade policy applied to route `text-gen` at 1798765500 :white_check_mark:

lin: mock PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/472 (UI sketches attached)

sara: +1 on counts/collapse. Also add a small "why it mattered" line (e.g., "impacted 12 tenants, avg extra latency 400ms").

jamie: Awesome — I'll summarize and move to the ticket. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
